name: Tequila Marjoram
original_name: テキーラ・マジョラム
source:
Tequila is a member of the Rune Angel Troupe and pilots the Emblem Frame Spell Caster.

Tequila is an alternate personality of Kahlua. Switching personalities involves a magical transformation that alters her mental and physical characteristics. The transformation is triggered when Kahlua consumes alcohol or a special medicine she makes.

Unlike Kahlua, Tequila is more impatient and flirtatious. Also, Tequila's bust size is bigger and she can use her full magical power.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Kahlua_Marjoram]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
